scores.supports: Microsoft (CIK 0000789019) filings have 0 hits for 'Vertical Aerospace'.

Lean MODERATE — not RED — because the absence is consistent with material-immateriality, not contradiction. The collaboration is plausible but the Microsoft side is silent.

scores.supports: USPTO ODP: 4 total applications, 2 granted patents (post-cutoff grant dates 2025); category split — 0 battery, 1 powertrain, 2 eVTOL/aircraft, 1 other (cabin).
scores.interpretation: Per heuristic 8 (UK-based assignees lower US grants — lean PASS if any portfolio exists), the existence of US filings supports 'in-house' framing. However, the 'designed in-house battery' claim is specifically asserted yet ZERO battery patents/applications appear — a Nikola-pattern lite. Given small absolute counts (4) and UK-issuer calibration, scored MODERATE rather than SEVERE. Note the company likely also files at UK-IPO/EPO; US-only view is partial.

scores.claim_text: SF Investment $50M from CEO-controlled Imagination Aero (related party); $25M received Mar 13, 2024; going concern dependent.
scores.supports: Imagination Aero appears in 13 SEC filings — all are EVTL's own 6-Ks/SC 13D. CEO Stephen Fitzpatrick CIK 0001911254 confirmed as related party.
scores.interpretation: Claim itself is verified — but content is the red flag. Pattern: (i) PCAOB going-concern warning, (ii) material weaknesses in internal controls UNREMEDIATED, (iii) only outside investor is the CEO via personal vehicle, (iv) $48.7M cash with ~$70M annual burn = ~7-8 month runway absent SF $25M, (v) extends only to Q2 2025 with second $25M tranche. This is a financial-distress / insider-of-last-resort pattern. CEO buying time via personal capital, not third-party validation.
